## Pull Request template

Please go through these steps before you submit a PR.

1. Make sure that your PR is not a duplicate.

2. If not, then make sure that:

    a. You have tested the code yourself to ensure it builds correctly and functions as intended.

    b. Any new user-facing strings are added to `DynamicNotch/Localizable.xcstrings`, not hard-coded.

3. **After** these steps, you're ready to open a pull request.

    a. Target the `main` branch. (This fork has no `dev` branch.)

    b. Give a descriptive title to your PR.

    c. Describe your changes. PRs should also include a screen recording or screenshots showing the change.

    d. Put `closes #XXXX` in your description to link your PR to the issue(s) it fixes (if any).

IMPORTANT: Please review the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) file for detailed contributing guidelines.

**PLEASE REMOVE THIS TEMPLATE BEFORE SUBMITTING**
